notes: «قال شعبة كتب إلي وقرأته عليه» is Shu'ba's note on the mode of transmission (a written copy read back), not a new link: Shu'ba is already in the chain
«قال أخبرني إبراهيم» — Mansur's own transmission, so Ibrahim follows Mansur
the Prophet's action and words are reported by Ibn Mas'ud, the last link
